2609.05079.title: TruthInsightBench: An Evidence-Grounded Benchmark for Automated Evaluation of Open-Ended Scientific Discovery Agents
2609.05079.paper_summary: Autonomous coding agents are increasingly proposed as AI-scientist systems that conduct analyses and write research reports, but executing a prescribed analysis is not the same as making a discovery. Existing benchmarks are configured for reproduction: tasks, data, and rubrics are built around a hidden target study, and recovery of its result is rewarded. We present TruthInsightBench, a benchmark configured for discovery. Its 40 blind tasks, drawn from 40 peer-reviewed studies across 10 scientific domains, expose only a neutral scientific objective and frozen data; source conclusions, expected values, and analysis paths are withheld, leaving the agent to determine what claim the data support. A fixed LLM-based judge scores the evidentiary maturity of an agent's own claims along six dimensions, operationalized as 29 artifact-grounded items, with automated, deterministic aggregation and no per-instance human grading, so evaluation can be repeated automatically as agents evolve. On one frozen base model, four coding agents form a narrow plateau (58.4-60.3 of 100) with no statistically reliable pairwise separation: they execute and document analyses competently, with comparatively strong evidence auditability and novelty, but largely lack the discriminating acts that establish a trustworthy claim (controls, robustness, falsifiability, and cross-dataset generalization). The bottleneck is scientific judgment rather than coding, and genuine discovery remains out of reach. TruthInsightBench makes this gap a measurable target; data and scoring code are at https://github.com/TruthInsight-stack/TruthInsightBench.
2609.05079.paper_summary_zh: 自主編碼代理越來越多地被提議作為進行分析和撰寫研究報告的 AI 科學家系統，但執行預定的分析並不等同於發現。現有的基準是為了重現而配置的：任務、數據和評分標準圍繞著一個隱藏的目標研究建立，並且恢復其結果會獲得獎勵。我們提出了 TruthInsightBench，一個為發現而配置的基準。它的 40 個盲任務來自 10 個科學領域的 40 篇同行評審研究，只暴露出中立的科學目標和靜態數據；來源結論、預期值和分析路徑被隱藏，讓代理決定數據支持的主張。固定的基於 LLM 的評審在六個維度上評分代理自身主張的證據成熟度，這六個維度具體化為 29 個基於文物的項目，並且使用自動化、確定性的聚合，沒有每個實例的人為評分，因此評估可以隨著代理的演變自動重複。在一個靜態的基礎模型上，四個編碼代理形成了一個狹窄的平臺（58.4-60.3 分滿分 100 分），沒有統計上可靠的成對分離：它們能夠勝任地執行和記錄分析，並且具有相對強的證據可審計性和新穎性，但在建立可信主張的區分行為上大體上缺乏（控制、穩健性、可證偽性和跨數據集的泛化）。瓶頸在於科學判斷而非編碼，真正的發現仍然遙不可及。TruthInsightBench 使這一差距成為可衡量的目標；數據和評分代碼可在 https://github.com/TruthInsight-stack/TruthInsightBench 獲得。
